svg.title: State replication bandwidth. PurrNet used 34% less downstream bandwidth than FishNet across the state replication tests. NetworkTransform + SyncVars, 100 connections, 20 Hz.

cc:Work.dc:title: State replication bandwidth. PurrNet used 34% less downstream bandwidth than FishNet across the state replication tests. NetworkTransform + SyncVars, 100 connections, 20 Hz.
cc:Work.dc:description: Arithmetic mean: MoveY, MoveWander, SyncVars. 100 objects · 10 s per test · on-wire server downstream · 1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes. One benchmark run; no repeat variability measured. Native replication behavior differs. Fusion uses Photon relay. Full methodology at the link below.
